one_line: Gajapati king Kapilendra Deva and his master temple-builders shaping late medieval Kalinga architecture in Bhubaneswar and Puri.

appearance.age_look: Kapilendra looks mid-40s, solid and broad-shouldered; the lead silpi (architect-artisan) looks early-30s, wiry and agile.
appearance.face: Kapilendra has a strong oval face, wheat-brown complexion, sharp nose, trimmed black moustache, a small tilak on his forehead and calm, commanding eyes; default expression is focused, dignified resolve. The silpi has a slightly narrower face, sun-browned skin, high cheekbones, and lively observant eyes, with a default expression of concentrated enthusiasm.
appearance.hair: Kapilendra’s thick black hair is pulled back into a neat, low knot at the back of his head, partly covered by a simple golden cloth turban banded with a thin red stripe; the silpi’s black hair is tied into a short, practical top-knot at the back of the crown, with a simple red cloth band around his head.
appearance.costume: Kapilendra wears a full-length, long-sleeved cream-coloured cotton angarkha-style tunic reaching mid-calf with side tie closure, over a deep-red dhoti wrapped to the ankles in the Kalinga style with a broad gold border; a mustard-yellow patka (sash) with subtle woven motifs is tied around his waist, and he has modest gold kadas on his wrists and a single thin gold chain with a small pendant, plus simple leather sandals. The silpi wears a knee-length off-white cotton tunic with three-quarter sleeves and a plain round neck, over a faded indigo-blue dhoti tied just above the ankles with a narrow white border, a brown cotton tool-belt sash around his waist holding small tools, and goes barefoot; both are fully and modestly clothed in draped garments appropriate to 15th-century eastern India.
appearance.signature: Kapilendra holds a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a red cord in one hand and rests the other on the silpi’s long wooden measuring rod, while the silpi carries a straight wooden measuring rod marked with notches and a metal-tipped stylus tucked into his waist-sash.

ref_desc: Kapilendra Deva is a wheat-brown, strong-built king with a trimmed moustache, low knot under a simple golden-red turban, wearing a cream long-sleeved angarkha, deep-red dhoti and mustard sash, holding a palm-leaf manuscript beside his barefoot silpi with indigo dhoti, off-white tunic and a brown tool-belt carrying a wooden measuring rod and metal-tipped stylus, all in cream, deep red, mustard yellow, indigo blue and brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet showing Kapilendra Deva and his lead Kalinga silpi standing together as late medieval Kalinga temple patrons in Bhubaneswar–Puri: Kapilendra is mid-40s, strong-built, wheat-brown, with an oval face, trimmed black moustache, calm serious eyes and a small tilak, thick black hair drawn into a low knot partly covered by a simple golden cloth turban with a thin red stripe; he wears a long-sleeved cream cotton angarkha reaching mid-calf with side ties, over a deep-red dhoti wrapped to the ankles with a broad gold border, a mustard-yellow patka with subtle woven motifs tied around his waist, modest gold wrist bangles, a thin gold chain pendant and simple leather sandals, fully and modestly clothed. Beside him, the silpi is early-30s, wiry, sun-browned, with high cheekbones, keen eyes and black hair in a short top-knot held by a red cloth band; he wears a knee-length off-white cotton tunic with three-quarter sleeves over an indigo-blue dhoti tied just above his ankles with a narrow white border, a brown cotton tool-belt sash holding small tools, and is barefoot. Show Kapilendra holding a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a red cord, one hand resting lightly on the silpi’s long straight wooden measuring rod marked with notches, while the silpi carries the rod and has a metal-tipped stylus tucked into his waist-sash. Use a restrained palette of cream, deep red, mustard yellow, indigo blue and brown, and present them front-facing with clear views of face, hair, clothing layers, jewellery, and the measuring rod and manuscript as their shared signature props, in a dignified, historically grounded anime style suitable for all ages.
